name: zerodom
description: Terminal-native DOM perception for red teams and AI agents. Hook into live Chrome sessions, cut HTML tokens 98.9% (median) and map attack surfaces from the CLI.
long_description: Deterministic AppSec & AI perception layer. ZeroDOM parses a live page into a flat, addressable list of clickable/fillable nodes (`[03] button 'Sign In'`) instead of an accessibility tree or raw DOM dump. Every CSS selector it returns is checked for actual document-wide uniqueness before being trusted, not assumed from an attribute — 99.00% of 10,756 audited selectors across 111 real sites resolve to exactly one element. Requires Playwright's Chromium to be installed once (`uvx --from zerodom playwright install chromium`) before first use.

tools.name: zerodom_parse_url
tools.description: Navigate to a URL and return its interaction graph — a compact text list like `[03] button 'Sign In'`. CSS selectors stay server-side, never entering the context window.

tools.name: zerodom_read_page
tools.description: Re-read the current page without navigating, so typed form state and scroll position survive. Use after an action changed the page.

tools.name: zerodom_find
tools.description: Search the current page's graph for nodes matching a phrase — cheaper than re-reading the whole graph when you already know what you're looking for.

tools.name: zerodom_click_node
tools.description: Click a node by id and return a diff of what changed on the page (+ appeared, - gone, ~ value changed), not the whole graph again.

tools.name: zerodom_fill_node
tools.description: Type text into a node by id and return a diff of what changed — e.g. a validation error appearing or an autocomplete list opening.
